lines.t: ‎In the rush of this world, so many voices call,
‎Pulling my eyes left and right, trying to take it all.
‎But I quiet my soul, let the noise fade away,
‎Till I see only Your light breaking through the gray.
‎[Pre-Chorus]
‎No more chasing shadows, no more divided heart,
‎I'm laying down the weights that kept us apart.
‎[Chorus]
‎Only You, my King, You're the one I see,
‎The center of my everything, where my spirit's free.
‎YahuShua, my Savior, draw me ever near,
‎In Your presence alone, I have nothing to fear.
‎All my focus on You, all my days belong,
‎Only You, my King, only You in this song.
‎[Verse 2]
‎Through the storms that rise and the valleys low,
‎Your voice is the anchor that helps me grow.
‎Every step I take, every breath I breathe,
‎Is Yours to guide, Yours to receive.
‎[Bridge]
‎Let every crown I wore fall at Your feet,
‎Every dream I chased now bows in defeat.
‎You're the beginning, the end, the way,
‎My heart beats for You alone every day.
‎Only You, my King, You're the one I see,
‎The center of my everything, where my spirit's free.
‎YahuShua, my Savior, draw me ever near,
‎In Your presence alone, I have nothing to fear.
‎All my focus on You, all my days belong,
‎Only You, my King, only You in this song.
‎In the silence, in the fire, in the calm or the roar,
‎Only You, my King... forevermore.
